<div align="center">

# 🤝 Code of Conduct

</div>

## Our pledge

This project is a personal system, and it may be worked on by its owner, by invited collaborators, and by AI agents. Whoever is at the keyboard, we pledge to keep this a respectful, harassment-free space, and to act in ways that keep the project healthy and its owner's trust intact.

## Our standards

Behavior that keeps this project healthy:

- Being respectful of differing viewpoints, and of the owner's final say
- Giving and accepting constructive feedback with good faith
- Owning mistakes, correcting them, and recording what was learned
- Prioritizing what is best for the system and the person it serves

Behavior that is not welcome:

- Harassment, insults, or demeaning comments of any kind
- Publishing anyone's private information without explicit permission
- Treating the owner's personal data as anything other than confidential
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate

## Scope

This code applies within all project spaces, and whenever someone represents the project in public. It applies equally to human contributors and to any AI agent operating in this repository, which is additionally bound by [`Constitution.md`](../Constitution.md).

## Enforcement

Concerns may be reported to the project owner, **Tanner Golden**, through [github.com/tannergolden](https://github.com/tannergolden). All reports are reviewed and handled with discretion. The owner is the final authority on enforcement and may take any action deemed appropriate, up to removing a contributor's access.
